selector.none: No warehouse yet – create one now

structure.title: Warehouse structure
structure.intro: Warehouse → zone → aisle → shelf → location. The shelves then appear in the warehouse layout, where they can be placed on the floor plan.
structure.refreshFailed: The warehouse structure could not be refreshed:
structure.emptyBody: Without a warehouse there are no locations for goods receipt, stock and picking. Create a warehouse and build zones, aisles, shelves and locations below it.
structure.deleteImpactWarehouse: {{impact}} will be deleted as well (and the walls and pick points of the warehouse).
structure.deleteHintBin: If the location has stock or is still in use, deleting is rejected.
structure.deleteHint: This only works if no location below it has stock and no replenishment or stocktake task is open; otherwise deleting is rejected and nothing is changed.

warehouseDialog.hint: The code is unique across the whole system (case-insensitive), e.g. WH01.

zoneDialog.hint: The code is unique within the warehouse.

aisleDialog.hint: The code is unique within the zone.

shelfDialog.hint: The code is unique within the aisle. The location codes stay unchanged; the position is changed in the layout editor.

binDialog.hint: The code is unique across the whole system (case-insensitive). Bin type and replenishment threshold are set with “Bin type” in the list.

binTypeDialog.title: Bin type of {{code}}
binTypeDialog.label: Bin type
binTypeDialog.hint: Hot pick: small, fast-access location on the pick route; if the stock falls below the threshold, a replenishment task is created. Reserve: stock from which hot-pick locations are refilled. Standard: everything else.
binTypeDialog.zeroNote: With a threshold of 0 the replenishment scan creates no tasks.

newShelf.title: Create new shelf
newShelf.noWarehouseManage: First create a warehouse under Warehouse structure.
newShelf.noWarehouseOther: A manager must create a warehouse first.
newShelf.needsStructureZone: There is no aisle yet. When creating, the zone “Z1” and the aisle “A1” are created automatically in warehouse {{code}} (can be renamed later under Warehouse structure).
newShelf.needsStructure: There is no aisle yet. When creating, the aisle “A1” is created automatically in warehouse {{code}} (can be renamed later under Warehouse structure).
newShelf.hint: Bins are arranged automatically along the X axis of the shelf. Codes: {{code}}-01, {{code}}-02, … Location codes are unique across the whole system - a shelf code whose bin codes already exist is rejected.

editor.title: Warehouse layout
editor.emptyBody: The layout shows the shelves of a warehouse. First create a warehouse with zone, aisle and shelf; the shelves then appear here and can be placed on the floor plan.
editor.structureHint: You maintain warehouses, zones, aisles, shelves and locations (codes, dimensions, bin type) under Warehouse structure.
editor.drift: The backend still returns walls in the old format (start/end instead of points). Please restart the backend (Ctrl+C → dotnet run --project src/Lager.Api) so that the schema upgrade and the new API take effect.
editor.loadFailed: Layout data could not be (fully) loaded:
editor.canvasHint: Top-down view. Mouse wheel or two-finger gesture zooms, dragging an empty area pans. Shelves can be moved (bins stay fixed to the shelf). Walls as polylines — click/tap adds a point, double-click, double-tap or “Wall done” finishes. End points snap to existing wall points (yellow ring). Pick points for start/end of the pick cart tours.
editor.wallDiscarded: At least 2 points needed — wall discarded
editor.deleteBinHint: If there is stock on the bin, deleting fails.
